gaps.explanation: Schedule is 55,774 above the statement. Detail revenue lines 0-7 come from the p8 Supplementary Budgetary Comparison Schedule for ALL FUNDS COMBINED (Total Revenues and Transfers 197,207), tagged governmental, but it combines the governmental funds with the utility fund: its 'Claims, Refunds, Reimbursements, and Other Local Receipts' 100,403 holds the governmental other receipts (p4: Interest 5,479 + Dividend 1,766 + Electrical Distribution System Lease 33,975 + Charges For Services 2,365 + Claims 165 + Licenses 956 = 44,706) and the utility fund's cash receipts (100,403 - 44,706 = 55,697 = p7 51,178 + 150 + 4,369); its Sales Tax 23,938 vs p4 23,861. The 100,403 line cannot be split by fund from the page. Per the user's per-fund detail ruling (2026-10-27, villages: a combined all-funds schedule is replaced by one line per fund column of the governmental and proprietary funds statements) and as done for Hubbard_FY2022, remove the p8 lines 0-7 (sum 197,207; their money is held by the per-fund lines added here and in the business-type revenue entry, so they would count it twice) and add the printed rows of the General Fund column of the governmental funds statement (p4; 13 rows = General Fund Total Revenues 141,421) plus the Fire Department Fund Interest Income 12 from the Other Governmental Funds combining schedule (p10; the statement's Other Governmental Funds column prints the same 12; Municipal Infrastructure Revenue Fund prints nothing). Check: 197,207 - 197,207 + 141,421 + 12 = 141,433 = p4 Total Revenues. Governmental expenditures (p9, 181,714 + 15,000) and the 15,000 transfer lines (detail 21-22) stay unchanged. The p8 budget column is lost with the removed lines.
